name: VOZHD CHETIRI — COMPILER & PERSISTENCE ARCHITECTURE
governing_question: Which physical empirical representations are actually necessary to produce, serve, validate, replay and audit Rawlsing's complete learned world while preserving source authority and leaving V3-generated life downstream?

C01.name: COMPLETE_TERMINAL_CONSUMPTION_AND_LIFECYCLE_AUDIT
C01.burden: Inventory complete five-lifecycle consumers and distinguish empirical-social learned products, structural products, serving surfaces and replay without treating current V3 usage as terminal demand.

C02.name: C11_AND_LEARNED_WORLD_INFORMATION_NECESSITY
C02.burden: Classify exact C11 and learned-world information requirements, including joint/multimodal/minority geometry, time/universe identity, validation state and possibility-field prerequisites.

C06.name: REPLAY_EXACTREF_ADAPTIVE_DISCOVERY_INTEGRITY

C07.name: COMPLETE_LEARNED_WORLD_PRODUCT_SERVICE_CONSTITUTION
C07.burden: Define complete learned-world empirical-social + structural product/service DAG, five lifecycle serving requirements and boundary to V3 life without inventing missing model authority.

C03.name: NATIVE_SOURCE_EXECUTION_RECONNAISSANCE
C03.burden: Measure actual SAV/DTA open/decode/full-read/selectivity terrain and amortizable transient working sets.

C04.name: I03_SOURCE_BACKED_EXECUTION

C05.name: AUTONOMOUS_DISCOVERY_AND_EMPIRICAL_LEARNED_WORLD_EXECUTION
C05.burden: Locate/freeze or identify absence of autonomous search law; model adaptive search, scaling, blind fixtures, validation states, higher-order geometry, multi-universe execution and cache reachability.

C08.name: INCREMENTAL_LEARNED_WORLD_BUILD_OPERATIONS
C08.burden: Trace invalidation/rebuild across empirical learned products, serving indexes, structural admissions and provenance.

C09.name: EXACT_PHYSICAL_AND_AUTONOMOUS_DISCOVERY_BAKEOFF
C09.burden: Compare A/B/C on parity, primitives, full autonomous discovery if executable, blind fixtures, scaling, five lifecycles, learned-product serving and repeated cache regeneration.

C10.name: DUAL_HOSTILE_SYNTHESIS_KILL_COURT
C10.burden: Attempt separate engineering and ontology-capability falsification against provisional synthesis.
